feeds.title: Pole Convention Blog
feeds.description: The International Pole Convention (PoleCon), celebrates the diversity of the pole dance/pole fitness community. Come to learn, share and grow with men and women of all shapes, sizes, ages, ethnicities and fitness levels then stay for the community.

feeds.title: Pole Athletica News
feeds.description: Learn to pole dance for fitness and fun at Sydney leading Pole Fitness Studio. They offer pole dancing lessons and courses to women and men of all skill levels.

feeds.title: Poledancerka Blog
feeds.description: You'll find different news about pole dancing and its varieties, pole dancing equipements. At Poledancerka we offer you the thinnest knee pads on the market, cute leggings, seductive bodysuits and more.

feeds.title: The Pole Physio Blog
feeds.description: The Pole Physio is an APA Titled Physiotherapist in Melbourne, Australia. Driven by a passion to help others and a fascination with body mechanics & injuries, The Pole Physio is here to help the pole community. Our blog will provide the necessary tools to prepare your body for the demands of pole and aerial and empower you on your journey!

feeds.title: Pole Dance Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Everything you need to learn how to pole dance for fitness at home including dancing poles, online pole dancing lessons, pole fitness clothing, grip aids, and gear. PoleFitnessDancing is about becoming a fit, strong, and empowering woman, regardless of weight, to feel sexy from within through pole dancing for fitness.

feeds.title: Sway Pole Dance Wear News
feeds.description: Exclusive pole dancing and pole fitness clothes, handcrafted in PL. Custom made tops and bottoms with unique, pin-up inspired designs. Your way, sexy way, Sway.

feeds.title: Chrome Chronicles
feeds.description: This blog is created by Eilish Foxen. She's been pole dancing for two years at the fabulous glitter cave 360 Pole Dancing in Bristol, UK. This is the place where she documents her adventures in the world of Pole Dance.

feeds.title: Basic Invert 78 - A Pole Dancer Blog
feeds.description: I am a pole dancer and a teacher of pole dancing and this is my blog dedicated to covering everything about pole dancing, aerial silk and lyra hoop dance forms. You will also find me reviewing dance poles, crash mats and other great pole dancing products I have used and tried for your reading pleasure.

feeds.title: Confessions of a Twirly Girl - A blog about pole dancing and learning to love yourself
feeds.description: This blog blossomed in 2010 to chronicle my adventures in pole dance. I talked too much about weight loss and bad diet 'science.' Join me on my journey toward enlightenment. I believe showing gratitude helps lead to a true mind, body and spirit connection, and a more joyful life. Yoga and pole dance are still my favorite methods of movement.

feeds.title: The Pole Room - Pole Dancing Classes Melbourne
feeds.description: Pole Dancing Classes and Courses Melbourne. This pole dancing blog is filled with news, student stories and other useful insider information. Their mission is to provide pole and aerial fitness for all in a fun, encouraging, inspiring and safe space.

feeds.title: Pole Fit Freedom Blog
feeds.description: Helping you get the most from your portable dance pole! We are a group of pole dance instructors from around the web and we made this blog packed full of well-researched information but also with years of personal experience using portable dance poles both in a professional and home-based environment.

feeds.title: Milan Pole Dance Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on all of the latest tips and tricks in the pole community. Blog posts cover Pole Dance Tips, Body Positivity, Exotic Pole Dance, Pole Dance Clothing, Pole Dance Lifestyle, and Pole Training. Milan Pole Dance Studio is an oasis of pole dance and aerial arts.

feeds.title: Irish Pole Dance Academy Blog
feeds.description: Irish Pole Dance Academy is the friendliest pole dancing classes in Dublin City Centre! Their mission is to create a supportive, welcoming and fun environment where your needs and goals as an individual are recognized and supported. A place where creativity and expression are met with encouragement and the support of a greater community.

feeds.title: BoomKats.com Blog
feeds.description: Our pole dance clothes - printed shorts, tops and more - will brighten your pole dance training! Classy and amusing pole graphic prints! All handmade in EU.

feeds.title: Poleitical Diaries
feeds.description: Blogging about my journey with pole, one bruise at a time.

feeds.title: Mel Nutter as Baudelaire Blog
feeds.description: Mel has been dancing since 2011, training at Sydney Pole, Art of Pole, and Sydney Dance Company. Mel is available for consultation on both pole dance choreography and tutorials, as well as yoga instruction and personalised vinyasa to help you reach your goals.

feeds.title: Love Pole Kisses - Pole Dancing & Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Love Pole Kisses is a Pole Fitness blog created to help those who need it to reach their goals. Discover the benefits of pole dancing at Love Pole Kisses. Their pole fitness tips & exercises are suitable for anyone, including complete beginners.

feeds.title: Pole Passion
feeds.description: Pole Passion was founded in 2003 with the ambition to educate and provide a new form of fitness for women incorporating personal growth for all abilities and backgrounds. They offer practical, emotional, and therapeutic support to clients in tailor-made interventions that aim to address a range of underlying issues. Subscribe to keep up with latest updates from this blog.

feeds.title: Pole Witch - Pole Dancing Witchy Style Blog
feeds.description: Hey I'm Sheena! Pole Witch is a blog about my obsession, Pole Dancing! I am a Canadian Pole Dancer performer, artist, athlete, instructor, competitor, witch from Ontario, Canada.

feeds.title: North Pole Dance Blog
feeds.description: North Pole Dance studio blog, news, promotions, and some useful advices on your journey to perfection in pole dance, belly dance, and yoga.

feeds.title: Studio 3sixT - Pole Dance Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Studio 3sixT is Colorado's pole, dance and fitness studio. Whatever fitness level you are, you will find a class to fit your needs.

feeds.title: X-POLE Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to X-POLE, the world of pole and aerial sports! Here you'll find anywhere in the world of pole exercise and dance.

feeds.title: The Pregnant Pole Dancer
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Roxy A Pole Dance Instructor And Mum-to-be From Sydney Australia.

feeds.title: Pole Dance Academy Blog
feeds.description: The Pole Dance Academy delivers a fun way to stay fit, feel sexy and look fabulous! Get fit the fun way at the best pole dance studio in Sydney! They aim to promote pole dancing, stretching, handstands, choreography acro and floorwork as a great way to improve your self-confidence and your fitness.

feeds.title: Pole Harmony
feeds.description: Exploring the art of creative expression through movement. Pole Harmony was a pole and aerial dance fitness studio on the southeast side of Indianapolis. Kody Parker, has maintained the Pole Harmony brand to continue blogging in the newly revamped lifestyle blog.

feeds.title: Push Pole Blog
feeds.description: A fantastical blog about all things pole. Push Pole, a brand for pole dancing addicts and aerial enthusiasts, launched in 2016. The blog was created to provide an exciting space for all things pole and aerial related.

feeds.title: Diary of a Pole Addict Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Michelle and I'm a pole addict!

feeds.title: Train for Pole
feeds.description: Train for Pole is a website for Pole Dancers, but it's not strictly about Pole Dance. It's about life as a pole student and a soon-to-be personal trainer. This blog provides on and off pole training, nutrition and lifestyle for pole dancers.
